profile.headline: Compiler Engineer and PL Researcher
profile.summary: Software engineer and programming languages researcher. My expertise includes domain-specific language (DSL) design and implementation, functional programming, type systems, compilers, human factors of programming languages, and all aspects of software variation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer for the first stage of the two-stage compiler for Cogent, a natural language-like knowledge representation language for building trustable, explainable hybrid AI systems.

The first stage of the compiler:
 * Lexes, parses, and disambiguates concrete syntax.
 * Performs static analyses, e.g. type checking, entity and relationship inference, reference resolution.
 * Provides language services for the IDE and LLM-based editing assistance agents.
 * Generates the intermediate representation used by the second stage.

Wrote and maintained the Cogent language reference.

Collaborated with other teams to improve compiler and language integration with LLMs to improve the accuracy of agents that generate and repair Cogent models.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming Languages · Program Analysis · Software Engineering · Programming · Git · Compilers · Functional Programming · Scala · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Compiler Construction · Large Language Models (LLM) · Scientific Writing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed smart/green energy software systems in Rust 😎 and Objective-C 🙀.
 * Designed and implemented a framework for scriptable energy system simulators.
 * Integrated Tesla Powerwall with the Savant Power host system.

Major contributor to Frame, an open-source DSL based on Harel’s statecharts.
 * Led design and implementation of Rust code generator and runtime system.
 * Supported the adoption of Frame within the company.
positions.insights: Skills: Domain Specific Languages · Program Analysis · Software Engineering · Programming · Rust (Programming Language) · Git · Compilers · Compiler Construction · Linux

positions.title: Assistant Professor
positions.description:
40+ academic publications in programming languages and software engineering.
 * Two Best Paper awards at international conferences.

Recruited, managed, mentored, and funded a diverse research group.

Won and executed a $1.6M, 4.5-year grant to improve robustness of highly configurable systems.
 * Led a team of faculty, students, and staff working on the project.
 * Designed and implemented the DSL that was our core technical contribution.
 * Delivered software on-time that passed all evaluations.

Taught courses on PL theory, functional programming, and modularity.
 * Designed curriculum; developed course materials, assignments, and evaluations.
 * Delivered multiple lectures per week to up to 200+ students.
 * Earned consistently excellent course evaluations.

Organized and co-chaired events at international conferences.

Reviewed and made publishing/funding recommendations for academic journals, conferences, and government agencies.
 * Best Reviewer of 2018 by the Journal of Software Systems and Modeling.

Founded and led a well-attended programming languages reading group.

Faculty advisor for the OSU Functional Programming Club.
